facts: push_message visibility can render plugin parts verbatim in chat and/or HUD
submitted=True means locally accepted, not final user delivery
current host judges/audits messages:push but documentation says refusal and push_message pre-check are planned, not implemented
plugin push_message is translated into proactive_message for main_server
ai_behavior controls the LLM callback mode independently from visibility
visibility=chat renders plugin blocks directly through render_chat_blocks before the proactive callback is built
proactive ai_behavior submits the LLM callback to submit_proactive_callback
visibility=hud sends agent_notification directly to the websocket after the callback submission block
silent/blind skips the LLM channel while the HUD sink can still fire

observed_reusable_ideas: core-agent notification receiver deduplicates by event ID and treats acknowledgement as durable receipt
AIRI exposes plugin-host and desktop notification primitives
broader_external_search.decision: do_not_replace_neko_host_or_copy_airi_runtime; these ideas do not provide an insertion point that can gate N.E.K.O's existing direct chat/HUD sinks

acceptance_gap.required_contract: all companion-authored user-visible plugin/desktop-notification outputs must pass surface-specific final admission immediately before publication
counterexamples: plugin push_message visibility=['chat'], ai_behavior='blind' can render a system bubble without entering proactive delivery
plugin push_message visibility=['hud'], ai_behavior='blind' can render an agent_notification while the LLM delivery channel is intentionally skipped
non_gap: plugin push_message ai_behavior='respond' callback itself already enters the native proactive delivery manager
operational status/configuration toasts are not automatically XiaoYu companion-authored output and must not be indiscriminately suppressed

candidate_contract.candidate_goal: machine-verify the native acceptance gap and define the minimum seam needed before any runtime patch is considered
candidate_contract.retirement_condition: Delete the probe when the pinned N.E.K.O host has one final-admission seam covering companion-authored plugin chat/HUD publication and the probe's counterexamples no longer bypass that seam.
candidate_contract.contract_visibility: delivery_floor_v1 explicitly lists desktop_notification and plugin_triggered_output as BLOCKED_NATIVE_GAP_PROBE until repaired

conclusion: KEEP_AS_PROBE_ONLY. Do not mark desktop_notification or future_plugin_triggered_output as delivery-floor PASS, and do not add a managed core patch until an executable native-gap probe passes and a separate implementation reuse decision exists.
